items.name: Build Your Number
items.desc: A fiscal-year revenue planning workspace for constructing and pressure-testing your annual Net ARR number from the bottom up.

items.name: My Actions & Alerts
items.desc: A unified work-list combining every task a user owes — commitments captured in account plans alongside system-generated, trigger-driven tasks fired by changes on opportunities and accounts (e.g., risk signals, stale data, or required follow-ups). Each item carries its source, due date, and status, so open and overdue work is tracked in one place instead of scattered across plans and records. It's the action layer of the app: insights and plans become concrete to-dos.
